_comments: This file is copied to ~/.shuttleterm.json the first time ShuttleTerm launches.
You can also add and edit hosts in Settings. You do not need to create the file by hand.
Per-host keys: name, cmd, after, startup, theme, font, title, reconnect
Groups: { "Work": [ {host}, {host} ] }. Add Group in Settings, or set Group on a host.
restore_windows: true reopens terminal windows on launch; coding-agent sessions resume where they left off
lock_after_sleep: true hides terminals after sleep or screen lock until Touch ID or the Mac password
align_grid: 5x4 or 4x3 — how many cells Align uses in a row or column
